Based on the provided documents, the EdgeForce team's rollback procedure change stemmed from a bug called the "Model Update Rollback Error" — rollbacks during AI model updates were happening incorrectly (i.e., the system failed to properly revert to the prior model state when a rollback was triggered). This issue was tracked in Slack channel #bug-juliamartinez-EdgeForce and was resolved via PR https://github.com/salesforce/EdgeForce/pull/50. The team also drew a parallel to a similar "Failed Rollback of Deployment Updates" issue in Kubernetes (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/1085) as a relevant reference for improving their rollback process.

The documents don't provide further technical detail on exactly what was wrong in the rollback logic beyond it being "incorrect rollbacks during model updates."
